profiles.label: Batman: Arkham Shadow 1.4.1
profiles.summary: OVRPort's recommended patches: they replace the Meta Platform SDK loader, which otherwise crashes at start, and pass the Unity Oculus hardware and Meta XR Audio checks. Patch before installing; if the unpatched store copy is already installed, uninstall it first (this deletes its Android saves).

profiles.label: North Star 1.0.1
profiles.summary: OVRPort's recommended patches pass the Unity Oculus hardware check, without which VR does not start. patch_disable_meta_xr_audio_telemetry stops Meta XR Audio's telemetry from aborting the game under Android's ARM translation; it needs ovrport 1.2.4 or later. The game does not use the Meta Platform SDK. Patch before installing.

profiles.label: Assassin's Creed Nexus VR 207706
profiles.summary: The game renders gameplay at a fixed 85% of the recommended eye size (its Quest 2 profile, which OVRPort pins; reporting a Quest 3 through Android crashes it at start). Direct mode reports a 35% larger size, so gameplay renders about 15% above the headset's resolution and is scaled down; it held 90 fps at 1.18. OVRPort's shim offers Application SpaceWarp, which the game enables (it creates motion-vector swapchains and paces itself for a half-rate compositor that AXRB does not have), so it is hidden from the game.

profiles.label: Marvel's Iron Man VR 0.2.1
profiles.summary: Runs the unmodified store APK in direct mode: provides the com.oculus.systemdriver adapter its older Oculus loader looks for, reports a Quest (Oculus) device for Unity's hardware check, and hides hand-tracking extensions from this game. The game also needs a compatible Meta Platform initialization package, which AXRB does not include. Startup was reached in the emulator; direct mode is not yet verified in a headset.
